decision: roadmap doc-7 D40: glade test gates compile errors by dependency. Invalid classes and their transitive dependents are compile errors; every other selected test runs; the run fails when any class is excluded.

routeApplicability.deploy: Every row is a check-only metadata deploy: the gate decides which saved project classes compile, and Salesforce reports an invalid class and its dependents as component failures of a deploy.
routeApplicability.anonymous: Does not apply. Anonymous Apex cannot declare top-level classes and cannot leave a class invalid while others compile: a block compiles as one unit against classes already saved, and a saved class is never invalid. Dependency invalidation exists only for deployed classes, and glade runs the gate only in glade test over project classes.

provenance.transport: check-only metadata deploy at the row's API version: sourceApiVersion and every class -meta.xml apiVersion are the row API unless classApis sets a class's version; rows with tests run RunSpecifiedTests
provenance.normalization: none: componentFailures fullName, lineNumber and problem, and runTestResult failures and successes, are copied verbatim and in deploy order
provenance.nativeRuns: A check-only deploy with a compile error runs no tests, even requested ones: GATE2-07T requests BRGIndepTest beside the invalid BRGBad and gets no test result. Glade models an org where the invalid class was never saved, so G07 and GATE2-07T take their runtime values from runtimeTwin G11: identical BRGIndep and BRGIndepTest sources apart from the row tag (runtimeTag), captured without the invalid class.
